## Ingredients
- to taste for the pasta:
## Method
1. 300 g of white flour, 70 g of butter, 1 whole egg + 1 yolk for the filling: 200 g of ricotta, 100 g of raw ham, 80 g of provolone, 3 tablespoons of chopped parsley, 1 egg, oil for frying, salt and pepper. For the filling, dice the ham and cheese, put them in a bowl, add the ricotta, parsley, beaten egg, salt and pepper.
2. Mix well to combine the ingredients.
3. For the pasta, add the butter in pieces, the egg, the yolk, and a pinch of salt to the flour.
4. Knead everything, moistening with a little water if the mixture is too hard.
5. Roll out a thin sheet and on half of it place small mounds of filling well spaced apart; cover with the other half.
6. Cut the calcioni with a round cutter and fry them in hot oil, turning them once with the appropriate spatula.
7. Place them on paper towels and serve hot.
